minor.issue: Always rotates preview_token even if a valid one already exists. SiteModePanel calls this unconditionally when preview_enabled is false, which will silently break any documented preview URL (e.g. pv_c3b797fcdafc58d4e70e320f) the next time an admin opens Site Mode on a tenant with preview_enabled unset. Consider making regenerate a no-op when preview_token is already present + preview_enabled true, or gate the SiteModePanel useEffect on missing token only.

ui_bugs.issue: The live-hero container has data-hero but is MISSING data-speed and data-intensity attributes. Spec explicitly requires 'the sm-hero-live-render data-speed/data-intensity' to change instantly as sliders are dragged so acceptance tests can observe pre-save live updates. Add data-speed={sm.motion_speed ?? 1} data-intensity={sm.motion_intensity ?? 1} to the wrapper div at line 106-107.

integration_issues.flow: Site Mode publish toggle rapid switching
integration_issues.issue: Firing sm-publish-draft -> preview -> live in quick succession triggered one 'Could not save Site Mode' toast (visible in Site Mode screenshot). Final state (live) still persisted correctly on refetch, and page/block counts were preserved, so this is a UX/race condition on rapid PUTs — likely the setSm optimistic update overwriting an in-flight response. Consider serialising saves or disabling toggles while busy.

action_items: HIGH: Add data-speed and data-intensity attributes to sm-hero-live-render in SiteModePanel.tsx so slider drags mutate them live before save (required by acceptance spec).
MEDIUM: Guard SiteModePanel's regenerate-on-mount so it does not rotate an already-valid preview_token; also consider making /preview/regenerate idempotent when a token is already active.
LOW: Serialise/debounce Site Mode publish toggles to avoid the intermittent 'Could not save Site Mode' toast when clicks land while a previous PUT is in-flight.

rca of the issue: sm-hero-live-render is missing data-speed/data-intensity because the wrapper div at SiteModePanel.tsx line 106-107 only sets data-testid + data-hero. The tuner's onChange handler mutates local sm.motion_speed/intensity state but there is no attribute on the live-render container to observe the pre-save value, so automated acceptance tests cannot verify 'changes BEFORE any save'. Fix: add data-speed={sm.motion_speed ?? 1} data-intensity={sm.motion_intensity ?? 1} to that div.
